expected.notes: Two 100 USDT trades at the same price (no path) 190 s apart, with two intervals the cube did not observe: 60 s -> 120 s and 150 s -> 175 s. The price is assumed to hold between trades, but dwell inside a gap is not attributed to any cell: trade 1 holds 10 s -> 200 s minus the gaps = [10, 60) + [120, 150) + [175, 200), split at column edges 56.25 / 112.5 / 168.75 s: 46.25 s col 0, 3.75 s col 1, 30 s col 2, 25 s col 3. Trade 2 holds 200 s -> the read's edge 337.5 s (25 s col 3, 56.25 s col 4, 56.25 s col 5). Covered dwell per column (all rows): 46.25, 3.75, 30, 50, 56.25, 56.25: the remainder of each column is unattributed time (the first 10 s before the first trade, and the gaps), which a column's dwell share must not hide. Cutoff 360 s = base 6.4, closed 6.
